mapper.select: SELECT NICKNAME FROM PARTICIPANT WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND PARTICIPANT_ID = #{participantId}

SELECT M.MESSAGE_ID , M.PARTICIPANT_ID , NVL(P.NICKNAME, '알 수 없음') AS NICKNAME , M.CONTENT , M.MSG_TYPE , M.CREATED_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE M LEFT JOIN PARTICIPANT P ON P.PARTICIPANT_ID = M.PARTICIPANT_ID WHERE M.MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}
